name: ourglass
description: Batore Personal Assistant — internal-use conversational AI assistant

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --parallel --filter @ourglass/web --filter @ourglass/api run dev
scripts.eval:ai: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @ourglass/evals run eval:ai
scripts.check:models: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @ourglass/evals run check:models
